definitions.gloss: economic effect; economic impact; economic benefit
definitions.explanation: The measurable influence that an event, policy, or project has on the economy, typically expressed in monetary terms.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The economic impact of the Olympics is enormous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}→数十億円：28377_suujuuokuen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{試算|しさん}→試算：08326_shisan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The economic effect of the new station opening was estimated at tens of billions of yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画する：29396_kikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: To boost the economic impact of tourism, the entire region planned events together.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (economy) + ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (effect). Very common in news and policy discussions, often used to quantify the financial benefit of major events, infrastructure projects, or government policies. Japanese media frequently report {経済効果|けいざいこうか} figures for things like the World Cup, cherry blossom season, or new bullet train routes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: the economic effect is significant
- {経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見込|みこ}む→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧: to expect economic benefits
- {経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試算|しさん}→試算：08326_shisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to estimate the economic impact
- {経済効果|けいざいこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to boost the economic effect
- ⟦{波及|はきゅう}→波及：09042_hakyuu⟧{経済効果|けいざいこうか}: ripple economic effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経済的影響|けいざいてきえいきょう}: economic influence (more neutral; can be negative or positive)
- {景気効果|けいきこうか}: business stimulus effect (focuses on stimulating the economy)
- {費用対効果|ひようたいこうか}: cost-effectiveness (ratio of cost to benefit)
